prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: concussion. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1174; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a sideswipe collision during a lane change. Insured vehicle and claimant vehicle both sustained right-side body damage. Claimant reports neck pain and headache at the scene and has since been diagnosed with a concussion. Claimant is not represented by counsel. Initial contact made by phone; claimant was advised of the claims process and that the adjuster cannot give legal advice.

Entry 2: Recorded statements obtained from both drivers. Insured states they checked the mirror but did not see the claimant vehicle in the adjacent lane before moving over. Claimant states they were in the lane and had already begun to brake when contact occurred. Police report requested and pending. Liability appears to lean toward the insured, subject to review of the report and scene photos.

Entry 3: Medical documentation received from claimant's treating provider confirming a concussion diagnosis, with restrictions on screen time and driving until symptoms resolve. Claimant asked how the claim affects medical coverage. Adjuster explained the difference between bodily injury and medical payments coverage and suggested the claimant may wish to consult an attorney for questions about their rights. Claimant said they would think about it.

Entry 4: Vehicle inspection completed for both vehicles. Damage estimates received and under review. Rental vehicle arranged for claimant through the insured's coverage pending liability determination. Follow-up call scheduled to check on symptom progress and to request updated medical records.

Entry 5: Claimant reports ongoing headaches and difficulty concentrating at work, and has requested a copy of the claim file. Adjuster informed claimant of the file request process. Medical records request sent to treating provider. Liability review remains open, and bodily injury evaluation will be deferred until treatment status is documented.
